about_the_game:
Each Ark possesses its own unique characteristics.

  • Rain of Blades: [Sky-Covering Shower], [Shadowless Dance]

  • Blooming: [Full Bloom], [Brilliance]

  • Galaxy: [Milky Way], [Supernova]

  • Thunder: [Lightning Strike], [Thunderclap]

  • Celestial: [Radiance], [Annihilation]

While the power of each individual Ark is immense, they begin to create incredible synergies when they meet.

  • Combine the Galaxy and Explosion Arks for [Entropy], causing every explosion to react with stars and become comets.

  • Merge the Rain of Blades and Blooming Arks for [Fleeting Glory], painting a scene of flower petals scattering with every slash.

  • Fuse the Flame and Explosion Arks for [Inferno Blossom], imbuing explosions with fire for even greater damage.

  • Unite the Galaxy and Abyss Arks for [Blood Star], where darkness-infused attacks create new meteor fragments upon executing an enemy.

What makes this truly boundless is that there are no restrictions between cards. Due to this limitless potential for expansion, the number of synergy combinations grows exponentially as you progress.

Beyond these, the variety of cards is immense: Blue Sigil, Solar Fragment, Dark Moon, Darkness, Eclipse, Light & Shadow, Sacred Fire, Creation Star, Meteor Shower, Divinity, Nebula, Milky Way, Brilliance, Maple, Lightning, Thunder, Gust, Typhoon, Comet Code, Meteor Code, Entropy Bug, Glitch, Ignition, Extinguishing Flame, Scorching Heat, Full Moon, Frenzy, Remnant, Chaos, Shadow Weave, Phantasm, Ink Trace, Phantom Lightning, Heaven-Piercing Blade, Mortality, Shadowless Dance, Emergence, Storm Wave, Stardust, Lava Zone, Armageddon, Apocalypse, Overlap, Turbulence, Gale Rush.

Each of these cards has a distinct characteristic befitting its name, and they intertwine to form even more spectacular combinations and particle effects. Unleash these boundless cards and wipe out the endless hordes of enemies swarming toward you!
